title: Sales pipelines
description: Manage active and archived pipelines. Opportunities and history are retained.
accessNote: Existing permissions still control access to individual opportunities.
dealCount: {count, plural, one {# visible opportunity} other {# visible opportunities}}
archiveBody: This pipeline and all its opportunities leave active work, including opportunities you cannot see.
restoreBody: This pipeline returns to the active list. Access to its opportunities is restored under current permissions.
historyNote: Records and history are retained. Restoring a pipeline does not grant additional access.
errorConflict: The pipeline settings changed. Refresh the list and review the current version before continuing. Your selection and search are retained.
errorDenied: You can no longer manage this pipeline. Refresh the list to review your current access.
errorFailed: The change could not be saved. Try again. Your selection is retained.
errorUnconfirmed: The change could not be confirmed. Refresh the list and review the current state before trying again.
errorUnavailable: Archive management is not enabled right now. Your data has not changed. Refresh the list.
errorLastActive: At least one pipeline must remain active. Create or restore another pipeline first.
stateChanged: This pipeline status has already changed. Close this window and review the current list.
reloadHint: Reload this page to see the current version.
errorDefaultPipeline: This is the default pipeline. Choose another default pipeline before archiving it.
errorFreshAuthRequired: Verify your identity again in account security, then return here. Your selection and search are retained.
verifyIdentity: Verify identity in account security (new tab)
